svg.title: How RTK corrections reach the robots
svg.desc: Two paths from the Emlid RS3 ground station. Ground robots with an Emlid unit get corrections directly from the RS3 over LoRa radio. Quadcopters get them over the local network: the RS3 sends them to the RTKLib caster on the discovery server, and an NTRIP client on each quadcopter's Jetson fetches them and passes them through MAVROS to the flight controller, which sends them to the GPS over UAVCAN.
svg.text: Ground robots with an Emlid unit: LoRa
Quadcopters: local NTRIP and a caster
